$comment: The ONLY paths cleanup is allowed to touch. Nothing here may be hard-coded in C#.
Tokens: {USER_TEMP}, {WINDIR}, {SYSTEM_DRIVE}. Anything else is rejected at load time.
Every path is additionally checked against the forbidden roots in CleanupWhitelist:
Documents, Desktop, Downloads, the profile root, and bare drive roots are always refused.
UNVERIFIED: these paths came from model knowledge on 2026-07-26 and are listed in the
windows-verified-paths skill. Check them before any VM run.
